adjudication.rationale: Looking at line 253-254 in the diff: `const selectedCalendar = externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId;`. When externalCalendarId is falsy (undefined/null), the code searches for a calendar where `cal.externalId === externalCalendarId` (i.e., `cal.externalId === undefined`), which will never match any valid calendar. This means selectedCalendar will be undefined, and Google will receive no calendarId. The same bug exists at line 314-315 in deleteEvent. This is a real logic error - the find condition should use a different field (like credentialId) to locate the correct calendar, not compare externalId to the undefined externalCalendarId.
